title.narrative: WFP Strategic Outcome 5 to logistics/UNHAS in Somalia
WFPs strategiska mål 5 för logistik/UNHAS i Somalia

description.narrative: Denna insats innefattar ett stöd till WFPs landprogram, under strategiska mål 5 som innefattar stöd till logistik och UNHAs-flyg. Syftet med den föreslagna insatsen är att underlätta tillgången till befolkningen som drabbats av översvämningar för att tillhandahålla livräddande stöd och tidig återhämtning från svenska och andra partners. Insatsen kommer att bidra till kontinuitet i tjänsterna från både humanitära och utvecklingsaktörer.

This contribution is a support to WFP Somalia Country Programme Strategic Outcome 5, which includes logistics and UNHAS-flights. The objective with the proposed intervention is to facilitate access to the population affected by the floods to provide early recovery services by Swedish and other partners. The intervention will contribute to the continuity of services throughout the humanitarian and development spectrum.

This contribution is a support to WFP Somalia Country Programme Strategic Outcome 5, which includes support to logistic operations and UNHAS flights in Somalia.
The objective with the proposed intervention is to facilitate access to the population affected by the floods to provide early recovery services by Swedish and other partners. The intervention will contribute to the continuity of services for development support and humanitarian assistance.
WFP's Somalia country strategic plan (2022-2025) has five strategy objectives and objective five focuses on logistical support: "The humanitarian community in Somalia is better able to reach vulnerable people and respond to needs throughout the year".
